title: London awarded the 2012 Olympic and Paralympic Games
summary: IOC selected London to host the 2012 Games, triggering the Lower Lea Valley/Olympic Park delivery programme.
observed_change: Regeneration programme trigger for Stratford/Olympic Park and Lower Lea Valley.
limitations: Use as policy/regeneration trigger, not a planning permission.

title: London Olympic and Paralympic Games Act receives Royal Assent
summary: The Act created statutory powers and bodies needed to deliver the London 2012 Games.
observed_change: Governance framework for Olympic delivery and later legacy planning.
limitations: Legal source should be linked in part-2 ingestion.

title: Olympic Park planning permissions and site-preparation programme
summary: Olympic Park masterplanning and permissions moved from bid concept into delivery/site preparation.
observed_change: Large-scale land assembly, remediation, utilities and venue construction programme.
limitations: Date is month-level discovery seed; verify exact permission decision IDs in LLDC/ODA records.

title: Major Olympic Park construction phase begins
summary: Main Olympic Park construction and venue delivery accelerated after land clearance/remediation.
observed_change: Visible transformation from industrial/rail/waterway land to Games park and venues.
limitations: Month-level seed; confirm exact construction milestones from ODA/LLDC annual reports.

title: Stratford International domestic rail services open
summary: Domestic Southeastern High Speed services began serving Stratford International.
observed_change: High-speed rail access added to Stratford/Olympic Park area.
limitations: Station opening source should be Network Rail/Southeastern/Mitre in part 2; TfL layer only provides current context.

title: DLR extension to Stratford International opens
summary: DLR service opened to Stratford International, connecting the Olympic Park area to the Docklands/light-rail network.
observed_change: Transit access improved before London 2012.
limitations: Use TfL press release/opening chronology for final evidence.

title: Westfield Stratford City opens
summary: Large retail and leisure centre opened adjacent to Stratford station and Olympic Park.
observed_change: Major economic/retail anchor added to Stratford City.
limitations: Private operator source should be corroborated with planning/source records.

title: London 2012 Olympic Games opening ceremony
summary: Olympic Park hosted the Games opening ceremony and primary Olympic venues.
observed_change: Temporary event use of newly built park/venues; later legacy conversion followed.
limitations: Event date is Games opening, not park-public-opening date.

title: London 2012 Paralympic Games opening ceremony
summary: Olympic Park hosted Paralympic events after the Olympic Games.
observed_change: Continued Games use before legacy conversion.
limitations: Event date is Paralympics opening.

title: East Village begins residential occupation
summary: Former Athletes Village transitioned into East Village homes after the Games.
observed_change: Large housing delivery/occupation phase begins in Olympic Park area.
limitations: Year-level seed; validate exact first-occupation date and unit counts from LLDC/GLA records.

title: Chobham Academy opens
summary: New all-through school opened as part of East Village/legacy neighbourhood infrastructure.
observed_change: Public service/civic asset added to support new residential community.
limitations: School opening month seed; verify exact date from DfE/school record.

title: Copper Box Arena reopens for public legacy use
summary: Olympic venue reopened as a public sports and events venue.
observed_change: Games venue converted to civic/sport legacy asset.
limitations: Month-level seed; verify exact reopening date.

title: Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park north park opens
summary: Northern part of the Olympic Park opened to the public after legacy conversion works.
observed_change: Public realm/park access added after Games.
limitations: Use park-management source for exact boundary/opening scope.

title: New Pudding Mill Lane DLR station opens
summary: A relocated/larger Pudding Mill Lane DLR station opened to support Crossrail/area development.
observed_change: Transit station geometry/capacity changed near Olympic Park.
limitations: Need TfL/Crossrail source for exact station works details.

title: London Aquatics Centre opens to the public
summary: Olympic swimming venue opened for public/community use after conversion.
observed_change: Games venue becomes public sport/leisure asset.
limitations: Use official venue/LLDC source in final card.

title: Lee Valley VeloPark opens
summary: Olympic cycling venue opened as a public cycling facility.
observed_change: Sports venue/cycle facility added to legacy park.
limitations: Use Lee Valley/LLDC source for exact date.

title: Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park fully opens to the public
summary: South Park/plaza areas opened, completing the main post-Games public park opening sequence.
observed_change: Major new public park/public realm becomes accessible.
limitations: Geometry should distinguish north/south park and venue areas.

title: LLDC Local Plan adopted
summary: LLDC adopted a local plan for its planning authority area covering Olympic legacy development.
observed_change: Policy framework for development management and site allocations.
limitations: Month-level date in discovery pack; final should use exact adoption date from LLDC document.

title: Here East innovation campus opens in former press/broadcast centres
summary: Former Olympic media facilities transitioned toward Here East technology/innovation campus uses.
observed_change: Economic anchor / employment-space reuse of Games infrastructure.
limitations: Year-level seed; validate exact opening/occupation milestones.

title: Hackney Wick station redevelopment opens
summary: Station upgrade near the western edge of the Olympic Park improved access and interchange/public realm.
observed_change: Transport/public realm improvement supporting Hackney Wick/Olympic Park access.
limitations: Month-level seed; verify exact opening from TfL/Network Rail.

title: East Wick and Sweetwater neighbourhood delivery starts
summary: Residential neighbourhood phases on the Olympic Park moved into delivery.
observed_change: Housing pipeline/completion phase for Olympic legacy neighbourhoods.
limitations: Use PLD/LLDC application IDs and completion records for final dates/unit counts.

title: Revised LLDC Local Plan adopted
summary: LLDC adopted/replaced its local plan for continuing legacy-area planning.
observed_change: Updated policy framework for the Olympic legacy area.
limitations: Month-level date; final card should use exact adoption date.

title: ULEZ expands to the North and South Circular roads
summary: Ultra Low Emission Zone expanded from central London to the North/South Circular boundary.
observed_change: Air-quality/traffic-emissions policy context affecting inner London travel, including areas west/south of Stratford depending boundary.
limitations: Boundary relation to specific site must be computed; do not claim local air-quality causation.

title: Elizabeth line opens, with Stratford on the eastern branch
summary: Elizabeth line service launched; Stratford became part of the branded Elizabeth line network, with through-running later in 2022.
observed_change: Major east-west rail connectivity layer added/rebranded for Stratford.
limitations: Distinguish initial opening from later through-running timetable changes.

title: ULEZ expands to all London boroughs
summary: Ultra Low Emission Zone expanded London-wide.
observed_change: Environmental transport policy applies across Greater London, including Stratford/Newham.
limitations: Policy boundary event; air-quality effects require monitor/indicator caveats.
